cut: 1942-07-23 D-4 opening; before new D-4 contact events

resolution_classes.HARD: direct current-authority named wallet / explicit branch checkpoint
resolution_classes.DERIVED_CLOSED: reconstructed from accepted branch checkpoint/technical authority and frozen for event use
resolution_classes.WORKING_CLOSED: operational center required by the simulator where no exact named roster exists; frozen unless direct contradictory evidence appears
resolution_classes.CONDITIONAL: future availability only after stated date/event gate; never prebooked

Zuikaku.crew_state: VETERAN_HEAVY / high experienced-leader nucleus / medium-high cohesion

Shokaku.crew_state: VETERAN_NUCLEUS_REBUILT / high leader nucleus / medium cohesion rising through work-up

Ryujo.crew_state: MIXED_SUPPORT / medium experienced-leader nucleus / support-CAP oriented

operational_budget.major_anti_ship_wave_center: 50-58 D3A/B5N with 12-18 A6M escort is a normal maximum first major package while retaining CAP/search/reserve; larger launches require event-specific risk tradeoff
operational_budget.fast_recon: 3 D4Y1-C mission-ready; center employment 2 active confirmation/recontact + 1 reserve. Recon only; no D4Y bomber replacement credit in July 1942.
operational_budget.search_tradeoff: B5N carrier search sorties subtract directly from strike inventory; no free search aircraft pool.

Junyo.role: fleet/support reserve; not additive to Santo center

MI_survival_effect: Akagi/Kaga hull loss is not converted into total air-group annihilation: many aircraft/crews were airborne and survivors were recovered/diverted.
Yamaguchi survives with Hiryu; experienced strike leaders, navigators, maintenance/deck chiefs and carrier staff remain materially thicker than historical post-Midway Japan.
Survivors are concentrated into first-line Zuikaku/Shokaku rather than spread uniformly; Ryujo remains mixed/support quality.
Track veteran/multi-seat crew attrition separately from aircraft hull attrition; this advantage can be spent rapidly during FS.

long_range_land_attack_recon.use: Rabaul/PM/Solomons holding system contribution; long-range search, fixed-target and secondary anti-shipping. No continuous Santo CAP credit.
long_range_land_attack_recon.daily_budget: normally either 4-6 long-range recon/search sorties plus a smaller strike, or one 12-16 aircraft strike package if contact/range/weather permits; not both at full strength for free

land_based_air.guard: These are direct FS mission budgets, not total aircraft located in the Southeast Area. Local holding fighters at Rabaul/PM/etc. cannot be counted again as Santo CAP.

water_aviation.rabaul_kavieng_rotation_reserve: 6-9 serviceable E13A/F1M-class aircraft can rotate as replacements/staging assets; do not count simultaneously at forward nodes unless actually moved.

shipboard_floatplanes.platform_basis: Kongo + Kirishima + Atago + Takao + Maya + Suzuya + Kumano
shipboard_floatplanes.mix_working: about 9-11 E13A + 5-7 F1M among ready aircraft
shipboard_floatplanes.employment: 10-12 search/recontact assignments available in a high-search day; retain 4-6 for observation, liaison, recovery/standby. CL aircraft are not counted until a specific CL is attached.

water_aviation.doctrine: broad search -> suspicious-contact revisit -> fast confirmation -> track -> later position update; no all-weather persistent track or modern datalink

roles.I-32: long-range reconnaissance/attack boat; floatplane-capable; use scout plane only with event-specific exposure/recovery cost
roles.RO-33_RO-34: late closer-lane reinforcement; not retroactively on station at D-4

branch_operability.application: apply through arrival/on-station/recontact/survival, never as a submarine-force x1.3 multiplier

submarines.information_rule: structured contact reports improve handoff, but information ages; no submerged continuous fleet datalink
submarines.ordnance_fuel_guard: No pre-D4 torpedo expenditure is invented. Once D-4 events begin, fuel/torpedo expenditure is posted boat by boat.

capability_overlays: Type 93 practical same-condition hit probability +10-25% relative where solution/geometry permits; not percentage points and not a generic surface multiplier.
Mature reload/re-attack: first-to-second effective torpedo salvo roughly 12-20 min; early Kagero-class 15-25 min where applicable.
Kagero-class practical full-load speed around 34.6-34.9 kt and range ~5,300 nmi/18 kt working band; main advantage is schedule/speed robustness and lower machinery dropout.
Kagero machinery fault incidence -15-25% and unplanned yard days -10-20% in matching early-service conditions.
No U.S.-SG-equivalent night radar/fire-control is created; optical/plotting/formation improvements remain bounded.
surface_force.double_count_guard: A hull assigned to one default group cannot appear in another. Reassignment is allowed before contact but must be posted explicitly.

combat_armored_vehicles.reason: No named tank/armored unit is in the v070 Santo assault package; vehicle-performance overlay does not create a tank unit.

engineer_plant_utility_machines.examples: light tractors/graders/rollers/pumps/generator transport as actually allocated; no free bulldozers

support_weapons_working_close.note: These are post-PM working centers for the booked Santo package, not the untouched pre-campaign South Seas Detachment establishment.

branch_vehicle_effect_already_embedded.trucks_prime_movers_dispatchability: +5-12% relative before conversion into the closed serviceable counts
branch_vehicle_effect_already_embedded.repairable_24_72h_return: +15-35% relative if reachable and workshop survives

guards: Do not add vehicle dispatchability again: serviceable counts above already include the Branch maintenance layer.
Do not treat landing throughput as extra vehicle production or combat lethality.
Destroyed, drowned or abandoned vehicles do not reappear through repair statistics.
Pack/draft/manual transport remains materially important; this package does not motorize the 7,200-man assault force.

event_engine_fields_to_track: aircraft physical/serviceable/mission-ready by deck or node
aircrew quality and veteran/section-leader losses separately from aircraft
search sorties actually flown and contact information age
submarine on-station status, fuel and torpedo expenditure by hull
surface hull damage/fuel/ammunition and floatplane losses
vehicles: destroyed / mission-killed / repairable / abandoned / returned-to-service
engineer plant availability and runway/port material state
